data.cultural_impact: Apollo was one of the most significant and widely recognized deities in the Greek pantheon. He was often depicted with the lyre, a stringed musical instrument, and was considered a god of arts, creativity, and culture. The term "apollo" is now used in the Western world as a synonym for "sun god" - a symbol of light, warmth, and life-giving energy.
data.spiritual_significance: For ancient Greeks, Apollo was a god of music and poetry because he was believed to inspire these artistic pursuits. He was also considered a protector and healer, especially in the areas of medicine and prophecy. To follow the spirit of Apollo is to engage in creative and artistic pursuits, to seek knowledge and wisdom, and to feel the warmth and light of the sun in our lives.
